categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily engages in the design, research and development, production, and sales of polymer-modified protective materials. The main products are functional protective sleeves (accounting for 80.91% of revenue), which are widely applied in automotive, engineering machinery, rail transit, and telecommunications electronics industries.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company masters core technologies including material formulation design, product structure design, and molding processes. It employs a vertically integrated production system with self-developed capabilities for modifying materials such as PET, PA, PP, and PE resins. Production methods include spinning, weaving, extrusion, and composite processes. The company has obtained 28 authorized invention patents and 113 utility model patents.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Direct customers are primarily tier-one suppliers to major OEMs. End-market applications include: automotive (61.82% of revenue, with 30.21% growth), engineering machinery (Caterpillar, SANY), rail transit (CRRC Group), telecommunications electronics (Molex, TE Connectivity), and emerging sectors like aerospace, medical devices, photovoltaic, wind power, and energy storage.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with production bases in Shenzhen, Dongguan, Kunshan (Suzhou), Wuhan, Chongqing, and Jiangmen. International presence includes Hong Kong subsidiary for export sales and newly established Mexico subsidiary (JECAR TECH MEXICO) for North and South American markets. Domestic revenue: 76.02%; overseas revenue: 23.98%.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the midstream to downstream segments of the supply chain. It sources raw materials (resins, fibers, additives) from upstream suppliers, performs value-added processing and modification, and supplies finished protective sleeves to tier-one component suppliers who then serve OEMs.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include: (1) expanding product portfolio for emerging industries (aerospace, medical, photovoltaic, wind power, energy storage); (2) developing high-performance variants (ultra-wear-resistant, fire-resistant, salt-spray resistant); (3) advancing automation and smart manufacturing; (4) international expansion via overseas production bases; (5) enhancing R&D capabilities with 89 R&D personnel (11.32% of workforce) and 4.53% revenue invested in R&D.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through direct sales of functional protective sleeves and related products. Revenue is recognized when control of goods transfers to customers (upon delivery and customer acceptance for domestic sales; upon customs clearance for export sales). The company operates on a make-to-order basis with reasonable inventory management.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes in a fragmented market with three tiers: (1) multinational leaders with advanced technology and scale; (2) domestic leading enterprises (including the company) with improving capabilities and cost advantages; (3) small-scale producers. The company is positioned as a domestic leader, being one of few enterprises mastering functional monofilament formulation design and modification capabilities, with performance metrics comparable to foreign leaders.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: 2023 revenue: 643.7 million yuan (23.28% YoY growth); net profit: 139.7 million yuan (22.28% YoY growth); total assets: 824.6 million yuan (36.87% YoY growth); net assets: 647.8 million yuan (27.61% YoY growth). The company demonstrates consistent double-digit growth trajectory with improving profitability and asset base.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Key differentiators include: (1) vertically integrated production ensuring quality control and cost efficiency; (2) comprehensive one-stop service covering design, R&D, testing, and production; (3) customized solutions for diverse applications; (4) established relationships with major OEMs across multiple industries; (5) advanced certifications (IATF16949, ISO9001, ISO14001); (6) rapid response capability through geographically distributed production bases; (7) continuous innovation in high-performance materials for emerging applications.
